name: beumer-localchat
description: BEUMER Group LocalChat — offline, confidential document assistant. Desktop client and local services.

scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace @localchat/renderer
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && npm run build --workspace @localchat/desktop
scripts.package: npm run build:desktop && npm run package --workspace @localchat/desktop
scripts.package:win: npm run build:desktop && npm run package:win --workspace @localchat/desktop
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test --workspace @localchat/renderer && npm run test --workspace @localchat/health-service
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
